name: phuochai-web
description: Website danh bạ lưu trú & thông tin du lịch Phước Hải - NestJS + GraphQL + PostgreSQL + Next.js

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @phuochai/api" "npm run dev -w @phuochai/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @phuochai/api && npm run build -w @phuochai/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @phuochai/shared && npm run typecheck -w @phuochai/api && npm run typecheck -w @phuochai/web
scripts.setup:local: npm run data:prepare && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed && npm run codegen
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run verify:schemas && npm run verify:repo && npm run verify:content && npm run verify:addresses && npm run verify:editor:render
scripts.verify:api: npm run verify:queries && npm run verify:mutations && npm run verify:avatar
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run verify:editor && npm run verify:seed && npm run verify:api
scripts.docker:prod:seed: docker compose -f docker-compose.coolify.yml --profile tools run --rm seed
